title: Road through ocean
content: I very often have had this dream since I was 20 years old. I’ll be driving with my children in the car trying to get away from some sort of disaster. I always end up on a road that is now being flooded by the ocean. I can see the road going forward but in every other direction is angry sea as far as can be seen. The water is coming over the road to the point it’s leaking through the doors, and then usually at some point it floods enough that we begin to just float away into the waves. Has anyone else been on this road? I can see every detail in my mind because of how often I’ve had it.
